changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Comment') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Comment]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ParentID] [int] NULL, [CommentTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Body] [nvarchar](max) NOT NULL, [DateCreated] [datetime] NOT NULL, [CreatingResourceID] [int] NOT NULL, [OwnerObjectType] [varchar](50) NULL, [OwnerObjectID] [int] NULL, [VisibilityID] [int] NULL, [IsDeleted] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Comment_IsDeleted] DEFAULT (0) NULL, [DateEdited] [datetime] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Comment] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Comment_Parent') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Comment] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Comment_Parent] FOREIGN KEY([ParentID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Comment] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Comment] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Comment_Parent] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Comment_ParentID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Comment_ParentID] ON [dbo].[Comment] ( [ParentID] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Comment_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Comment] AFTER INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON; insert into [queue].[Task] ([Action], [Custom], [Object], ObjectID) select 'Notify', '1', 'Comment', ID from inserted where CommentTypeID in (2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9);

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: alter table Comment add Uid uniqueidentifier constraint DF_Comment_Uid default(newid()) not null GO CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Comment_Uid] ON [dbo].[Comment] ( [Uid] ASC )

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
alter table Comment add AssetID bigint null GO
update C set C.AssetID = A.ID from Comment C inner join Asset A on A.Object = C.OwnerObjectType and A.ObjectID = C.OwnerObjectID GO
delete Comment where AssetID is null GO
alter table Comment alter column AssetID bigint not null GO
alter table Comment drop column OwnerObjectType GO alter table Comment drop column OwnerObjectID GO
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Comment_AssetID] ON [dbo].[Comment] ( [AssetID] ASC )
changeSet.rollback: alter table Comment add OwnerObjectType varchar(50) null GO alter table Comment add OwnerObjectID int null GO update C set C.OwnerObjectType = A.Object, C.OwnerObjectID = A.ObjectID from Comment C inner join Asset A on A.ID = C.AssetID GO alter table Comment alter column OwnerObjectType varchar(50) not null GO alter table Comment alter column OwnerObjectID int not null GO alter table Comment drop column AssetID GO
